pipeline: S1 rom-census + S2 ap-source + S3 web batches (P1-P4, all controls passed) + decomp id-space ruling
method: position and vanilla-item fixes are mechanically double-sourced (S1 census x S2 reference crosswalk); S3 web batches were AI-sampled corroboration, not exhaustive; review stamps: verified = untouched and comparator-ok, accepted = fixed this pass or name-covered key drop, needs-work = open question below
openQuestions: check-009 / check-011 / check-025: event checks with no bufferIndex - no live detection path defined yet

per-dungeon map/compass item records (item-136..item-161) now carry the generic receive ids (map 0x33, compass 0x25): grants are palace-scoped by the engine and the items are dungeon-local, so the generic grant lands on the owning dungeon; vanilla chests still grant the generic records (item-052/item-038)
item-041 is itself the 3-bombs pack (receive 0x28); requirements use it as the bomb-capability proxy and chests grant it directly - no aliasOf needed, but a real capability item remains future work
mail tiers stamped 2 (blue) / 3 (red): the base mail is built-in tier 1 with no item record, so the family covers tiers 1-3 with records at 2 and 3

big-key receive-id stamping covered all twelve per-dungeon big keys (item-084..item-095), not only the nine referenced by requirements: two further dungeons have big-key chests with no requirements reference yet, and the first castle grants its big key via a key drop

resolved 2026-08-30 (vanilla-lock elimination pass): the former open questions on check-021/022 (pond gameIds), check-046/061/135 (standing masks), check-047/054 (room-292 collision), check-070/071 (ow3:m64 collision) and check-088 (roomFlag collision) are closed by the ledger entries of that pass; check-009 gained a certified standing detection. Still open from the original list: check-011 / check-025 event checks with no live detection path
